learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a clever animal fable, learn about thinking smartly before acting, and discover why wisdom is a great superpower!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We meet a special parrot who is not just beautiful but also very smart. He knows how to speak and understand things carefully.
The parrot finds himself in a difficult spot where he has to make a quick decision. Instead of panicking, he stays calm.
By using his clever brain and talking smartly, the parrot solves the problem. He shows that being wise is better than being strong.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Parrot Says Game
fun_activity.instructions: Play a game just like Simon Says but call it Parrot Says. You must only do the action if the leader starts with the words Parrot Says!

quick_recap: ⭐ The story introduces a smart parrot who faces a tricky problem.
⭐ Instead of getting scared, the parrot thinks calmly and uses his words.
⭐ We learn that using our brains and being wise can help us out of tough spots.
